channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Associação pede inelegibilidade de Tarcísio após ato em igreja
item.description: The Movimento Brasil Laico association requested an investigation and the ineligibility of São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) for holding a campaign event in a church, which they argue violates the secular nature of the state.

item.title: Delúbio critica Caiado: “Única coisa que sabe fazer é ser hostil a Lula”
item.description: Delúbio Soares, a candidate for federal deputy in Goiás, criticized Ronaldo Caiado for his hostile stance toward Lula, advocating for mutual respect among leaders and national pacification. He also opposed Donald Trump's tariffs and warned against foreign appropriation of Brazil's rare earth and oil resources.

item.title: Relatório da Oxfam mostra como os super-ricos dominam a democracia
item.description: Oxfam Brazil report reveals super-rich candidates have 4,000 times higher election odds than ordinary citizens, showing how wealth captures Brazilian democracy. In 2022, no candidate with assets below R$100,000 was elected, while millionaires (32% of candidates) won 58% of seats, perpetuating class, race, and gender inequalities.

item.title: Trump y Lula conversan durante más de una hora tras los recientes gestos hostiles de Washington
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump and Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held a friendly phone call lasting over an hour, discussing bilateral relations, the new U.S. tariffs on Brazil, and efforts against organized crime. They also addressed global geopolitical issues, including the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East.

item.title: Governo Trump vetou missão da Receita Federal após visita de Lula aos EUA
item.description: Following Lula's visit to the US in May, the Brazilian Federal Revenue Service organized a technical mission, but the Trump administration vetoed the initiative, sparking diplomatic tension. The episode highlights differences between Brazil and the US over fiscal and security cooperation.

item.title: Lula conversa com Trump por telefone e pede mais negociações contra tarifaço
item.description: Lula spoke with Trump by phone and urged continued negotiations to reverse the 25% tariffs on Brazilian steel and aluminum. The Brazilian president defended free trade and the historic relationship between the countries.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia novos nomes para equipe econômica
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced seven new members for his economic team, including Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa. The addition strengthens the advisory group for his 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: Lula diz a Trump que eles se gostam e não precisam de intermediários
item.description: President Lula called Donald Trump and said they like each other and don’t need intermediaries. They discussed tariffs on Brazilian products, organized crime, and global conflicts. The call lasted 1h20 and included several advisors.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro divulga integrantes da área econômica
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign announced seven economic experts to develop technical proposals for the government plan. The group joins Daniella Marques and Adolfo Sachsida in formulating economic policies.

item.title: Flávio diz que criminosos devem deixar o país até o fim do ano
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said criminals should leave the country by year-end and threatened arrests or police neutralization starting in 2027. He proposed harsher sentences, labeling gangs as terrorist groups, using technology to protect women, and maintaining Bolsa Família.

item.title: Saiba quem integra a equipe econômica de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) announced a 9-member economic team to draft his government plan, led by Daniella Marques and Adolfo Sachsida. The group includes researchers, professors, and former government officials with financial market and public policy experience, and will present proposals to the productive sector.

item.title: Em conversa ‘cordial’ com Trump, Lula rejeita classificação de facções como terroristas
item.description: Lula rejected the classification of criminal factions as terrorists in a cordial phone call with Trump, stating Brazil has its own tools to combat organized crime. Both leaders agreed to strengthen cooperation on security issues. Diplomatic tensions remain high due to trade disputes and mutual accusations.

item.title: Caiado condena postura de ‘fujões’ em debate: ‘Inaceitável no momento econômico que o Brasil passa’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, presidential candidate from PSD, condemned other candidates' absence from debates, calling their 'dodging' stance unacceptable given Brazil's economic crisis. He blamed the federal government's spending for high interest rates and advocated for austerity policies. Caiado supported reducing the work week but criticized the election-driven manner of the discussion.

item.title: ChatGPT, Grok e Google IA fazem ranking de melhores candidatos, e descumprem norma do TSE
item.description: ChatGPT, Grok, and Google AI violated TSE Resolution 23.755/2026 by generating rankings and scores for 2026 presidential candidates, which constitutes an electoral offense. The AIs ranked Ronaldo Caiado, Lula, Romeu Zema, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Renan Santos on a 0–10 scale, despite the resolution explicitly prohibiting AI systems from ranking, recommending, or expressing any form of electoral preference.

item.title: Apesar de ausência na Band, participação de Lula em outros debates não está descartada
item.description: Although Lula did not attend the Band debate, his presence in other presidential debates is not ruled out. Campaign aides assess that he may attend to avoid the perception of avoiding ideological confrontation, depending on the organizers' rules.

item.title: Roberta Luchsinger pagou cartão e financiamento de carro de Marcola, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police report that lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger paid over R$ 217,000 in personal expenses for Marcola, former chief of staff to President Lula, including credit card bills, car financing, and jewelry. Marcola claims the amount was a personal loan that has been repaid with interest.

item.title: Como estava o cenário da disputa Lula x Bolsonaro na pesquisa Datafolha de agosto de 2022
item.description: In August 2022, Datafolha showed Lula with 47% of voting intentions and Bolsonaro with 32%, a 15-percentage-point gap. In the simulated runoff, Lula led with 54% against Bolsonaro's 37%, while rejection of the former president stood at 51%.

item.title: Cientista político avalia as chances da criação de uma CPI do Lulinha
item.description: Political scientist Rodrigo Prando assesses that creating a CPI to investigate influence peddling allegations involving Lulinha is "very unlikely" at this moment. The effort faces a lack of opposition mobilization, focused on the 2026 elections, and a lack of political will from Senate and Chamber presidents Davi Alcolumbre and Hugo Motta to escalate confrontation with the government.

item.title: De ‘química excelente’ a tarifaço: as idas e vindas da relação entre Lula e Trump
item.description: The phone call between Lula and Trump, described as friendly, marked a new attempt to stabilize bilateral relations after months of political and commercial ups and downs. Lula advocated for restarting tariff negotiations, while Trump agreed to preserve ties and proposed new meetings between the two countries' teams.

item.title: Veja joias que amiga de Lulinha pagou para Marcola, ex-assessor de Lula
item.description: PF messages reveal that Roberta Luchsinger paid for jewelry and loans up to R$ 249,000 to Marco Aurélio Santana (Marcola), former chief of staff to Lula. The former aide left office in July 2026 after being investigated in an influence-peddling scheme linked to the Ministry of Health and INSS.

item.title: Flávio vai a Nova Iguaçu, onde ex-vice de Douglas Ruas e Paes faziam ato
item.description: In Nova Iguaçu, former mayor Rogério Lisboa (PP) broke with PL and led an event with 18 councilors supporting Eduardo Paes (PSD) for Rio governor. Almost simultaneously, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Douglas Ruas (PL) held a rally focused on public security, highlighting the fierce dispute for Baixada Fluminense voters.

item.title: Haddad propõe banco para financiar a reindustrialização em São Paulo
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), candidate for governor of São Paulo, proposes transforming the Desenvolve SP program into a development bank to finance the state's reindustrialization, ending the tax war. He also stated that the tax reform, set to take effect in 2027, should attract industries, and highlighted that competition with China and tax benefits for electric vehicles continue to harm sectors such as auto parts.

item.title: Impedido pelo TSE, Marçal promete ir a debate de qualquer jeito
item.description: Banned by the TSE, Pablo Marçal vows to attend the Band debate anyway, even if he cannot enter the studios. If blocked, he plans to stay at the station's gate and broadcast live via social media.

item.title: As três variáveis que podem mudar jogo eleitoral após caso Lulinha, segundo cientista político
item.description: Political scientist Rodrigo Prando identified three variables that could alter the electoral landscape following the Lulinha revelations: political exploitation by Lula's opponents, the president's and campaign's response, and the potential shift in political wear from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to Lula's. The electoral impact will depend on how these factors unfold in the coming weeks.

item.title: O motivo do silêncio de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre revelações do caso Lulinha, segundo cientista político
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has remained silent about the revelations involving Lulinha published by VEJA. According to political scientist Rodrigo Prando, Flávio is waiting for further developments before acting, fearing that an early attack could expose unwanted news about himself or his family. The opposition's response has been limited, with Carlos Viana defending a CPI and Mário Frias requesting a mixed commission, while many lawmakers prioritize the electoral calendar.

item.title: A Trump, Lula diz que alegações que embasaram tarifas "são infundadas"
item.description: Lula told Trump directly that the allegations underlying U.S. tariffs against Brazil are unfounded, citing issues such as deforestation, intellectual property, and the Pix payment system. In a call lasting over an hour, Trump agreed to resume negotiations on the tariffs, which can reach 37.5%.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da decisão de Mendonça sobre vazamentos do caso Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate leaks and breaches of confidentiality in the investigations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Lula. The ruling responds to a request from Lulinha's defense, who is the target of inquiries into alleged influence trafficking, and focuses on identifying officials or individuals with a functional duty to preserve secrecy rather than the journalists who published the stories. Veja magazine reports, confirmed by Poder360, revealed messages between Lulinha and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger exposing an intermediation structure between private interests and the federal government.

item.title: Crusoé: A trama das frases comprometedoras de Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: The article exposes compromising messages from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, seized by federal police, involving figures close to President Lula, including his son Fábio Luís and former chief of staff Marcola, hinting at potential political misconduct.

item.title: Saiba quem compõe a equipe econômica de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) expanded his economic team with seven new specialists, including economists, Ipea researchers, and former Ministry of Economy secretaries, to develop the government plan. The group brings experience from Brazilian and foreign universities, as well as the financial market.

item.title: Todos os empresários deveriam ter sido chamados para discutir o fim da escala 6 x 1, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, defended reducing the workweek to a 5x2 schedule but criticized how the debate over ending the 6x1 shift was conducted in Brazil, arguing the discussion was driven by electoral interests and that all business owners should have been invited to participate.

item.title: Lula liga para Trump e diz que tarifaço contra Brasil é baseado em alegações infundadas
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva called Donald Trump on Friday (21), stating that the latest US tariff hike against Brazil is based on unfounded allegations. The call comes amid an escalation in trade tensions between the two countries.

item.title: Conheço Lulinha desde criança e acredito em sua inocência, diz Delúbio
item.description: Delúbio Soares, former PT treasurer and federal deputy candidate from Goiás, defended Lulinha in an interview, stating he has known him since childhood and believes in his innocence. He also addressed the investigations into Marcola, calling for a thorough and unhurried inquiry.

item.title: CNH digital: app vai avisar motorista de passagem em pedágio free flow e dar acesso a canal de pagamento
item.description: The digital CNH app will now alert drivers about free flow toll passages and provide payment access, addressing criticism of the new system. In an election year, Lula's government suspended 3.4 million fines, requiring regularization by Nov. 16, 2026. Official launch on Monday.

item.title: Candidato do Psol vê patrimônio saltar 5.160% e lidera alta nas disputas estaduais
item.description: Ronaldo Mansur, the Psol candidate for governor of Bahia, declared to the Electoral Court a net worth 5,160% higher in 2026 compared to 2022, when he ran for lieutenant governor. This represents the largest asset variation among all gubernatorial candidates in Brazil in this election cycle.

item.title: Mendonça amplia inquérito do INSS e inclui vazamento sobre Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça expanded the Federal Police investigation into leaks from Operation Sem Desconto to include the probe into the disclosure of confidential data on Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha. The ruling orders the police to identify who had access to the material and how the information reached the press, while safeguarding journalistic source confidentiality. Mendonça excluded journalists responsible for the reports from the investigation.

item.title: Lula liga para Trump e diz que tarifas contra Brasil são infundadas
item.description: Lula and Trump spoke for 80 minutes about unfounded tariffs on Brazil, agreeing to resume negotiations. The leaders also discussed cooperation against organized crime and conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East.

item.title: Seja lulista ou bolsonarista, vida dura para os sommeliers de corrupção
item.description: The text discusses the phenomenon of 'corruption sommeliers' in the polarization between left and right in Brazil, focusing on cases like Fábio Lulinha and Flávio Bolsonaro. It highlights how each side uses rhetoric to mitigate accusations against allies while amplifying those against opponents. The critique suggests that supporters' views are emotionally driven and partial, hindering impartial judgment.

item.title: Michelle faz aceno a Raquel Lyra em Pernambuco, estado onde governadora candidata à reeleição busca aproximação com Lula
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro expressed sympathy for Governor Raquel Lyra by sharing a video of her at a restaurant, as Lyra strengthens ties with Lula's government to secure investments and electoral support in Pernambuco. Michelle's party has no gubernatorial candidate, and Flávio Bolsonaro struggles to find a platform in the state, where Lyra seeks reelection against João Campos (PSB).

item.title: PGR cita precedente de Fux para defender retirada de investigação sobre Lulinha do STF e que caso não tem relação com fraude no INSS
item.description: The PGR cited a precedent set by Minister Fux to request the transfer of the investigation into Lulinha and Roberta Luchsinger from the STF to the lower court, arguing lack of concrete evidence of active participation by a privileged authority. The case investigates alleged fraud in the INSS involving businessman 'Careca do INSS', but the PGR argues there are no sufficient elements to keep the case at the STF.

item.title: Lula diz a Trump em ligação que Brasil não precisa classificar facções como terroristas para combater o crime organizado
item.description: President Lula told Trump that Brazil does not need to classify criminal factions as terrorist groups to fight organized crime, rejecting the U.S. designation of PCC and CV. The call also covered U.S. tariffs, bilateral cooperation, and the Public Security PEC.

item.title: Caiado ataca “gastança” de Lula e promete juros menores
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate, criticized the Lula administration's fiscal policy, blaming increased public spending for high interest rates. He promised to lower interest rates if elected, citing 'wasteful spending' as the primary cause.

item.title: Na 25 de Março, Zema alfineta "pompa" de Lula ao falar sobre tarifaço
item.description: Zema, presidential candidate from Partido Novo, criticized Lula for not directly negotiating with the US over the tariff issue, accusing him of acting with 'pompa' and failing to address the problem. He advocated for a more proactive Brazilian stance in international relations, stating it is necessary to go to Washington to negotiate rather than wait passively.

item.title: Haddad promete criar banco estadual 'nos moldes do BNDES' para reindustrializar São Paulo
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) proposed transforming Desenvolve SP into a state development bank modeled after BNDES, focused on reindustrializing São Paulo, while criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro over the tax reform. Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), his opponent, expressed support for the federal tax reform, diverging from Flávio, who advocates for its review.

item.title: Lula fica 1h com Trump no telefone e fala de tarifas, guerras e PCC
item.description: Lula spoke with Trump for 80 minutes about tariffs, organized crime, and international conflicts. The tone was friendly, but no agreement was reached. Lula rejects the new U.S. tariffs as unfounded and advocates for negotiations.

item.title: Lula e Trump conversam sobre tarifaço; veja pontos abordados
item.description: Lula and Trump discussed trade tariffs and international cooperation in an approximately 80-minute call. Lula rejected U.S. allegations on deforestation and crime and proposed dialogue to resolve global conflicts, including the war in Ukraine. Brazil initiated evaluation of economic reciprocity measures against the U.S. in response to 25% tariffs.

item.title: Lula diz a Trump que Brasil não precisa de 'classificação' para combater crime organizado
item.description: Lula told Trump Brazil does not need an international designation to fight gangs like CV and PCC, as it has its own legal tools. Brazil opposed the US move, citing intervention risks. Trump agreed to strengthen bilateral cooperation on the issue.

item.title: Haddad vê mudança nas negociações Brasil-EUA se Trump e Flávio Bolsonaro forem derrotados
item.description: Haddad expects the defeats of Flávio Bolsonaro and Trump to alter Brazil-US relations, weakening the far right. He criticizes Tarcísio de Freitas and supports the Tax Reform and transforming Desenvolve São Paulo into a bank to reindustrialize the state.

item.title: Lula liga para Trump, que propõe retomada de negociações sobre tarifas
item.description: Lula and Trump spoke by phone about tariffs, organized crime, and global conflicts. The U.S. president proposed resuming trade negotiations, while Lula reaffirmed that the tariffs are unfounded. Both agreed to preserve strong commercial ties and deepen bilateral cooperation.

item.title: Em conversa por telefone, Lula diz a Trump que alegações dos EUA para tarifaço são 'infundadas'
item.description: Lula and Trump had a friendly 1-hour-and-20-minute phone call. The Brazilian president dismissed U.S. justifications for tariffs as 'groundless' and emphasized preserving bilateral negotiations. Both leaders agreed to resume technical talks and discussed cooperation against organized crime.

item.title: Lula liga para Trump, defende negociação e diz que alegações dos EUA para tarifaço são 'infundadas'
item.description: Lula called Trump and advocated for negotiations regarding U.S. tariffs on Brazil, deeming the allegations underlying the measure 'unfounded'. The friendly call covered trade, organized crime, and international conflicts.
